basics.name: Vitalii Serbyn
basics.label: Agentic Systems Architect
basics.summary: Agentic Systems Architect. I make AI agents reliable enough to run in production — agent reliability engineering (trajectory evals, false-green metering, evidence-binding, trust-tiered execution) and LLM cost engineering — for US, UK, and EU teams via Easelect LTD.

work.name: Easelect LTD
work.summary: Independent architect making AI agent systems reliable and cost-efficient for US/UK/EU teams.
highlights: Designed and built Ascend: a 27-agent (18 mature) multi-agent orchestration daemon with trust-tiered L0-L4 execution, policy gates, budget guards, and 1,178 automated tests
Built DW, an autonomous spec-driven development pipeline: 101 logged runs at a 0.94 pass rate, gated by acceptance checks
Built Crest, a LangGraph content engine with multi-model routing and multi-platform publishing
Cut own-platform LLM spend 58% ($82 to $34/month) via multi-model routing and semantic caching, without lowering output quality
Deliver fixed-scope agent production-readiness audits and LLM cost teardowns for US/UK/EU teams

work.name: EPAM, GlobalLogic, Startups
work.summary: Shipped production mobile, web, and cloud systems; led small teams and owned release trains.
highlights: Shipped a consumer app with 100M+ downloads and a Google Play Editor's Choice award (as engineer, in an employed role)
Delivered an 80-90% RPC cost reduction on a Web3 platform (as engineer, in an employed role)
Led teams of 3-4 engineers and owned release trains for high-traffic mobile apps
Introduced monitoring and incident routines with Prometheus/Grafana, reducing on-call noise
